correctness.rationale: All-degree logarithmic coefficients of the exact pgf are computed analytically. The sign of every even coefficient is decided by a ratio and degree two, with summability and boundary normalization proved. The classical thinning criterion is reduced to a parity-dependent canonical difference, whose infinitely many even cases are equivalent to a single inequality when the base ratio is at most one. Log-concavity for shape at least one uses convolution of log-concave masses; for smaller shapes the full Gamma-ratio expansion proves eventual positive second log-difference. Exact-fraction diagnostics (9791 checks) support but do not replace these proofs.
